 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. It's the second round of the Wisconsin Interscholastic Athletic Association football playoffs – or Level 2, if you prefer – and the matchups look to get tighter.
 We'll have reporters checking in from two Milwaukee-area games. Zac Bellman is covering Wisconsin Lutheran at Whitefish Bay and Michael Whitlow is covering Catholic Memorial at New Berlin West.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement We'll keep tabs on a few other games and we'll have all of the scores from around the state below.
 We'll be providing live coverage of the playoffs throughout the night. You can follow along here for the latest updates:
 Final: Whitefish Bay 14, Wisconsin Lutheran 7
 The Vikings defense kept the game alive for Wisco by forcing another turnover on downs at their own 30, but a game-tying drive was not to be.With three minutes left, a high pass by Cooper Sievert after the Vikings were backed up by penalty was intercepted by Mark Banks. Whitefish Bay would punt it back with 2:30 remaining, but the Vikings got backed up and turned it over on downs to effectively end the game and their season.Two Lateef Love Jr. TD runs were the difference in this Level 2 playoff game.Whitefish Bay advances to face the winner of New Berlin West-Catholic Memorial.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement End 3Q: Catholic Memorial 19, New Berlin West 16
 A scoreless third quarter sends us to the fourth thanks to two West turnovers on defense, including a pick off a deflection for Nathan Sockett. CMH was able to move the ball fairly well, but couldn't finish off drives in that period to extend its lead. NBW will start on the CMH 22 to start the fourth. 
 End 3Q: Whitefish Bay 14, Wisconsin Lutheran 7
 No scores in the third as we had a pair of long drives end with turnovers on downs deep in the opposing team's territory.Wisconsin Lutheran hit on a very similar play it sprung Vierck for the touchdown earlier in the game to get into scoring range, but turned it over on fourth-and-12 at the WFB 26. The Blue Dukes responded by driving to the Wisco 13 with their effective run game, but similarly turned it over on downs when facing fourth-and-four.Wisco has the ball as it seeks to erase a touchdown deficit and keep its season alive.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Halftime: Catholic Memorial 19, New Berlin West 16
 It's the Crusaders with a three-point lead after an eventful second quarter heading into the intermission. Nezih Hasanoglu III caught a 16-yard touchdown from Dalton Steinke and Dustin Roach tallied a go-ahead pick-six with West set up at the CMH 41-yard-line. Ben McFarlane did cap the end of the half with a 28-yard field goal for West to cut the deficit in half at the halftime whistle. 
 Halftime: Waterford 7, Pewaukee 6
 Pirates end the first half with an impressive drive that's finished off with a 3-yard TD pass in the final seconds of the half. PAT is wide right so Waterford still leads at the half.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Halftime: Union Grove 38, Waukesha South 7
 Union Grove adds on with 2-minute drill before half. Quinn Schultz 24 yd TD run.
 Halftime: Whitefish Bay 14, Wisconsin Lutheran 7
 We had a pair of scores within 19 seconds of game clock here midway through the second quarter to start the scoring. Lateef Love Jr. redeemed himself for the earlier fumble with a 6-yard TD run to get Bay on the board, then punched it in again from the I-formation for two points to follow.Wisconsin Lutheran answered a play from scrimmage later as Deacon Vierck took a dive on a slight backfield misdirection play and ran 82 yards to paydirt. Wisco opted for the PAT, which was converted to keep WFB ahead by a single point.The Blue Dukes answered with a drive capped by a 27-yard Love Jr. scamper for his second score of the quarter. He was stopped just shy of the goal line on the 2-pt try to keep it a one-score game.After the WFB defense forced a 3-and-out, Mace Miskel returned a punt deep in his own territory to the Wisconsin Lutheran 28 with just over a minute left in the half. A couple incomplete passes from Chase Wolter stalled the drive at the Wisco 18, and WFB opted to go for it on fourth-and-10 rather than try a 33-yard field goal. Another incompletion turned the ball over on downs before we got to half.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement End 1Q: Port Washington 21, Luxemburg-Casco 0
 All Pirates so far as they lead 21-0 after one quarter.
 End 1Q: New Berlin West 7, Catholic Memorial 7
 We're tied after one quarter of play in New Berlin tonight. Aidan Devine got the Vikings on the board first with a 38-yard touchdown run. The Crusaders answered that touchdown with a Ne'Vareon Flowers touchdown run where he plowed ahead from a couple yards out. However, West will start the second period deep into the red zone on the CMH 6 after a 55-yard catch and run from Zachary Hewitt. 
 End 1Q: Whitefish Bay 0, Wisconsin Lutheran 0
 Scoreless after one quarter between the Blue Dukes and Vikings in this playoff rematch of a 27-8 Whitefish Bay victory earlier this year. The lone highlight in a run-heavy quarter for both teams that drained the clock was a fumble recovery by Wisco's Liam Oertel that thwarted an otherwise promising Blue Dukes drive. WFB's Lateef Love Jr. put the ball on the turf on an outside run.Whitefish Bay has the ball back near midfield to start the second quarter after turning the Vikings over on downs at WFB's 30 in the final minute of Q1.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement End 1Q: Waterford 7, Pewaukee 0
 The Wolverines have made 2 impressive 4th down stops against an O Line with 2 Big Ten commits. Pirates are deep in the red zone to start Q2, though.
 1st quarter: Port Washington 14, Luxemburg-Casco 0
 This Jack Bunyan kid has The Goods. Completes a 55 yd pass and two plays later takes it in from 1 yard out. Kick is good as Port Washington now leads 14-0 with 6:35 left in the first.
 1st quarter: Waterford 7, Pewaukee 0
 Wild start to this one, as the Pirates drive into Wolverine territory but get stuffed on 4th down. Three plays later, Hunter Schneiker hits Mason Lusic over the top of the Pewaukee defense for an easy 64-yard touchdown pass. 7-0 Waterford, 5:40 Q1

 WIAA football second-round playoff games to watch around Milwaukee
 The Sweet 16 has arrived for many programs around the Milwaukee area .
 Overall, 25 programs from our coverage area are still alive and in pursuit of a gold ball in Madison next month. Fourteen of those 25 programs will face each other in seven all-area playoff matchups in the second round.
 We'll take a look at five of those seven matchups here in our games to watch this week.
